theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Build Your Financial Safety Net First
body: An emergency fund covering 3-6 months of expenses provides security before investing. Create a stable foundation for wealth building.
caption: Your emergency fund is like financial insurance, protecting you from unexpected life events. Start small, build consistently, and keep it easily accessible. #EmergencyFund #FinancialSecurity #SmartSavings #PersonalFinance #WealthBuilding
